propositions: The enrich drain gate's pending_enrichment check runs O(ticket-count) and costs 486-740 ms on every write against a declared 20 ms budget, a 25x overrun caused by scanning every ticket directory and calling reduce_ticket which issues ~24,000 filesystem metadata operations per gate check

The gate's latency compounds under concurrent writes due to vnode cache saturation; N simultaneous agents each walking the full store creates positive feedback that extends the write window and increases overlap of subsequent gate invocations
The linear walk makes the budget warning fire on 100% of writes in large stores, destroying its signal value as an observability mechanism and rendering it noise rather than a breach indicator

The fix introduces an O(1) marker file at .rebar/enrich-gate.json holding next_eligible_ns to short-circuit the gate on quiet stores while degrading to a full scan if the marker is corrupt or missing, remaining self-healing via TTL expiry and append-driven invalidation
